verdict.rationale: Loops documents event-triggered workflows: you send an event via POST /events/send or incoming webhooks to start published workflows, and you can build onboarding, trial, and re-engagement flows around product events. Workflow graphs, including branch nodes, can be created and edited from code, which suits AI-native users. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that event-triggered workflows work as described, and detailed docs on rule conditions and action types beyond sending email.
